lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters are distributed across the mid-to-posterior flank. A group of four primary centroids forms a non-equilateral quadrilateral pattern posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical axes of elevated luminance cross horizontal rows of high-intensity blobs, most notably in the transition zone between the gills and the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Visible linear features on the dorsal-lateral surface exhibit a stark vertical luminance gradient, with pixel values decreasing sharply along the ventral boundary of each horizontal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density field of micro-blobs, significantly smaller in diameter than the flank spots, is concentrated on the cranial region anterior to the first gill slit.
